Initially, the list of employees who actually received gifts in "gift_assignments" was empty because these assignments were not correctly extracted or represented in data. Thus, the non-giver (Fred) was not correctly identified because the comparison relied on this incomplete data, leading to the incorrect conclusion that Rebecca was the non-giver. The error primarily stems from failing to implement a robust gift-matching strategy, leaving a gap that incorrectly identified the givers.
